subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated `diagnostics.otel.serviceInstanceId` configuration contract, or rely exclusively on the standard `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` mechanism?
rationale: The repository has a high bar for new config surfaces, and current OTel already provides a standard mechanism; implementation cannot safely choose whether an OpenClaw-specific convenience and precedence contract is worth maintaining.

options.title: Use standard OTel configuration
options.body: Remove the dedicated config and environment inputs and document `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=service.instance.id=...` as the single supported path.

options.title: Keep a config convenience
options.body: Retain the OpenClaw key only after defining its precedence, completing metadata, and explicitly handling or excluding preloaded SDK mode.

recommendation.title: Use standard OTel configuration
recommendation.body: Remove the dedicated config and environment inputs and document `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=service.instance.id=...` as the single supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: The OpenTelemetry v2 migration established the affected SDK ownership and resource architecture, making this the strongest available domain-history signal.
